categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: retail of bulk snacks (量贩零食) and cultivation and sales of edible fungi (食用菌). The bulk snack segment involves chain retail stores offering a wide variety of snack products, while the edible fungi segment focuses on research, factory cultivation, and sales of mushrooms such as enoki, shimeji, and deer antler mushrooms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The edible fungi business relies on modern biotechnology and factory-based cultivation using agricultural by-products as substrates, with automated control of growth conditions to ensure quality and yield. The bulk snack retail segment employs a direct procurement and streamlined supply chain model, leveraging digital transformation and data analytics to optimize product assortment and store operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include individual consumers purchasing from retail stores and franchisees in the bulk snack segment, and distributors and end consumers in the edible fungi segment. The company serves a broad consumer base across various provinces in China, with products mainly sold in East China, South China, Central China, and expanding into other regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with retail stores in 29 provinces including Jiangsu, Anhui, Zhejiang, and others. The edible fungi production bases are located in Fujian (Zhangzhou) and Jiangsu (Nanjing), covering major domestic markets and extending to Southwest, Northwest, North, and Northeast China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. For edible fungi, it is involved in production and sales (midstream to downstream). For bulk snacks, it functions as a retailer and distributor, managing procurement, warehousing, logistics, and retail sales (downstream).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the bulk snack retail network with a focus on brand unification and supply chain resilience, and advancing R&D in edible fungi breeding, strain improvement, and factory cultivation technologies. The company emphasizes digital transformation, product innovation, and talent development to sustain growth and competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales: bulk snack products sold via company-owned and franchised retail stores, and edible fungi sold through distributors and direct sales. The company also earns franchise fees and brand usage fees from franchisees in the bulk snack segment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading player in the bulk snack retail sector with a rapidly expanding store network and a recognized national brand. In the edible fungi industry, it is among the top domestic producers with advanced factory cultivation capabilities. Competitors include other regional snack retailers and edible fungi producers, but the company leverages scale, technology, and brand strength as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported a significant revenue increase to approximately RMB 32.33 billion in 2024, a 247.86% growth from the previous year, driven mainly by the bulk snack segment. Net profit attributable to shareholders turned positive at RMB 293.52 million, recovering from losses in prior years. The company operates over 14,000 retail stores nationwide and has a daily edible fungi production capacity of 379 tons, reflecting rapid scale expansion and improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high cost-performance ratio products in the bulk snack segment, achieved through direct sourcing, supply chain efficiency, and a rich product assortment covering multiple snack categories. For edible fungi, it offers green, safe, high-quality products produced via modern biotechnology and factory cultivation, ensuring consistent quality and food safety. The integrated brand strategy and digitalized operations enhance customer experience and loyalty.
